hero_hello: Hello, my name is Daniel Farina, and I am a programmer!
hero_description: I develop APIs and web pages with the most popular tools on the market.
about_utfpr_1: My name is Daniel Farina. I was born in the state of São Paulo in 1998 ({age}) and graduated with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the Federal University of Technology – Paraná (UTFPR – Campus Campo Mourão, Brazil) in 2024, with a double degree as a Master in Informatics from the Polytechnic Institute of Bragança (IPB – Portugal).
about_utfpr_2: During my undergraduate studies, I studied basic data structures (lists, stacks, queues) and advanced ones (graphs, search trees). I also took classes in Artificial Intelligence, Distributed Systems, Compilers, Data Visualization, among other subjects that left a mark on me.
about_utfpr_3: I worked as a teaching assistant in the Numerical Calculus course and as an assistant instructor in Computer Networks for high school students. I took full advantage of academic events, especially the workshops and lectures of the Informatics Week (SEINFO).
about_atla_1: I interned at the start-up ATLA Ensino in Campo Mourão, where I learned the fundamentals of web applications: server operation (backend/API) and development of web and mobile applications (frontend) using Angular 2, Ionic, and Node.js.
about_atla_2: During the system implementation in Campo Mourão schools, the entire team made support visits, assisting with the installation of the application on teachers' phones and gathering suggestions for improvements and fixes to the system.
about_atla_3: Later, I became responsible for generating reports, performing aggregations in a MongoDB database, and rendering the results with the PDF.js library on the frontend.
about_viptech_1: Before traveling to Portugal, I was hired by Viptech, also in Campo Mourão, where I was exposed to new technologies, such as automated deployment with Azure DevOps Actions and microservices management using Kubernetes. I had my first professional experience with the relational database MySQL, and for communication between microservices, we used the in-memory database Redis.
about_viptech_2: I worked with NestJS, FastAPI, and React.js in the development of internal applications, as well as using .NET and Angular 2 in outsourced projects. In this project, the database used was Oracle, with several triggers configured to ensure data consistency.
about_ipb_1: In Bragança, Portugal, I was able to consolidate and deepen my knowledge. As a team, I developed a mobile application in Kotlin connected to a remote server (API) as a project for the Mobile Development course.
about_ipb_2: In the Software Architecture course, I participated in building a web application aimed at the local community. I also took Business Process Engineering and Software Systems Quality, where I learned about business process management (BPM) and practices for error analysis and identification.
